name: Opportunist (Combat)
body:
You only need the mere distraction of a nearby ally in order to slip past your enemy’s guard.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Reflexes, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit: Whenever you and an ally are threatening the same target in melee and your ally deals more than 10 damage to that enemy with a melee weapon, that opponent provokes an attack of opportunity from you. If your ally did 20 or more damage to the enemy, that enemy is also considered flat-footed for the purposes of your attack of opportunity. Any condition that would prevent you from making an attack of opportunity also prevents the use of this feat.
